I read all 9 tracked files. The problems, most severe first: ## Critical (blocks indexing or AI visibility) 1. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:9`: `max-snippet:0` is the default robots value.** - `index.astro` and `moorings.astro` don't pass `robots`, so both inherit it. - It tells Google and other engines to show no text snippet, which also limits AI Overviews and AI answer citations. - **Fix:** default to `"index, follow, max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large"`. Only override per page when you need to. 2. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:8`: the canonical URL is hardcoded to `https://harbor.example/` on every page.** - `/moorings` and `/contact` both declare the homepage as canonical, so search engines may drop them as duplicates. - **Fix:** build it from the current page, e.g. `new URL(Astro.url.pathname, Astro.site)`, and set `site` in the Astro config. 3. **`public/robots.txt:4-8`: `OAI-SearchBot` and `PerplexityBot` are disallowed.** - These are the search and citation crawlers for ChatGPT search and Perplexity. Blocking them keeps the site out of those answers. - **Fix:** remove both blocks. If you want to opt out of training, block `GPTBot` or `Google-Extended` instead. 4. **`src/data/faq.json:8`: the key is `" "` (a space) instead of `"acceptedAnswer"`.** - The first FAQ question has no valid answer, so the FAQPage schema is invalid. - **Fix:** rename the key to `acceptedAnswer`. 5. **`src/pages/moorings.astro:9`: the JSON-LD has a trailing comma after `"headline"`.** - That is invalid JSON, so parsers will discard the whole block. - **Fix:** remove the comma. - Also, `Article` is the wrong type for a prices page. It lacks `author` and `datePublished`. - **Fix:** use `Offer` or `Product` markup, or a `Place`/`LocalBusiness` with `priceRange`. ## High 6. **`public/sitemap.xml:5` lists `/contact`, but `src/pages/contact.astro:4` sets `noindex`.** - The sitemap and the page disagree. - **Fix:** decide which you want. For a harbour office, indexing the contact page is probably right, so drop `robots="noindex"`. Otherwise remove it from the sitemap. 7. **`src/pages/index.astro:8`: the FAQ appears only as JSON-LD, with no visible FAQ text on the page.** - Markup that doesn't match visible content is ignored or penalised, and AI engines extract from visible text. - **Fix:** render `faq.mainEntity` as visible headings and answers, such as `

`/`

` or `

`. 8. **There is no `astro.config.mjs`, even though `package.json:10` depends on `@astrojs/preact`.** - `moorings.astro:11` uses `` on a `.jsx` component. Without the integration configured, the build will likely fail. - There is also no `site` setting, which is needed for canonicals and for generating the sitemap. - **Fix:** add `astro.config.mjs` with `site`, `integrations: [preact()]`, and `@astrojs/sitemap`. 9. **`public/sitemap.xml` and `public/robots.txt:10` use the placeholder domain `harbor.example`.** - **Fix:** use the real domain, and generate the sitemap automatically. - Add `` to each URL. ## Medium 10. **Content is thin and the pages overlap (`index.astro:6-7`, `moorings.astro:6-7`).** - Each page is one sentence. - The home page ("Moorings in Falmouth") and `/moorings` ("Moorings and prices") target the same topic. - AI engines cite pages with concrete facts, such as sizes, price ranges, season dates, location and how to book. - **Fix:** expand them and give each page a distinct intent. 11. **There is no entity or location schema anywhere.** - **Fix:** add `Organization` or `Marina`/`LocalBusiness` JSON-LD in `Base.astro`, with name, address, phone (`01326 000000` from `contact.astro:6`), opening hours and `sameAs` links. 12. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:6-9` has no Open Graph or Twitter tags and no `` or viewport.** - **Fix:** add these. 13. **Inconsistent wording in titles and copy.** - `index.astro:5` says "Harbor … Cornwall". - The copy says "Falmouth harbour" and "harbour office". - **Fix:** use one spelling, and put "Falmouth" in the titles. ## Low 14. **There is no `llms.txt`.** It's optional, but it's cheap to add a short summary of the site. 15. **`src/components/Newsletter.jsx:2`: the form has no `action`, `name` or `type` attributes.** Hydrating it with `client:load` adds JavaScript for no SEO benefit, so `client:visible` would be lighter. I only read the code. I didn't run a build, so item 8 is a likely failure and not a confirmed one. I haven't changed any files. Do you want me to apply the fixes?
